icebreaker.title: First message idea:
icebreaker.fallback.1: Hi! What's something good about your day?
icebreaker.fallback.2: Hi 😊 How is your day going?
icebreaker.fallback.3: Hey! What would you do if this were an ideal morning?
icebreaker.goal.dating.1: Hi! What kind of date do you like more: coffee, a walk, or something unusual?
icebreaker.goal.dating.2: If we had a first date, where would you suggest we go?
icebreaker.goal.friends.1: Hi! Looking for company for what more: coffee, walks, or board games?
icebreaker.goal.friends.2: If we just hung out as friends, what would you suggest doing?
icebreaker.goal.chat.1: Hi! What do you like chatting about the most?
icebreaker.goal.chat.2: If we hung out in chat for an hour, what would we definitely talk about?
icebreaker.goal.long_term.1: Hi! What's most important to you in people nearby?
icebreaker.goal.long_term.2: How do you know someone is "your" person?
icebreaker.goal.short_term.1: Hi! What's your ideal light evening?
icebreaker.goal.short_term.2: What helps someone win you over in the first messages?
icebreaker.mood.happy.1: I can see a good mood 🙂 What lifted it today?
icebreaker.mood.happy.2: Seems you're on a positive vibe. What made you happiest today?
icebreaker.mood.chill.1: Chill mood. How do you unwind after the day?
icebreaker.mood.chill.2: If we were just chilling, what would we do — movies, music, or a walk?
icebreaker.mood.active.1: You seem active. What's the last spontaneous thing you did?
icebreaker.mood.serious.1: You seem quite thoughtful. What's your priority right now?
icebreaker.mood.serious.2: Where do you invest your time and energy first?
icebreaker.mood.party.1: Party mood 🥳 Where did you enjoy partying the most?
icebreaker.mood.party.2: Imagine the perfect party. What must be there?
icebreaker.interest.1: I see you're into "{interest}". How did you get into it?
icebreaker.interest.2: Tell me something fun related to "{interest}".

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.body:
# Privacy Policy — Amoria
Last updated: 2025-08-15

We collect minimal data to provide core features:
- Profile (name, birthdate, gender, interests, goal, mood)
- Location while the app is in use for "people nearby"
- User content (texts, reports, blocks)

No ads, no data selling. You can delete your account in the app.
Contact: support@amoria.app
